items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Johnny Dodge could have played with him on a certain reason.

ctx.x: Bichet neither, huh? No. Bichet didn't read when he was here. How about Dodge? Did he read then? Dodge read more than we read, but not much.
Not much. No. How about some of these other boys, like Charlie? Charlie?
